caption: The video captures a wide, calm pond viewed from a fixed shore-side position beneath a bright blue sky filled with white cumulus clouds. Floating lily pads scatter across the water, a denser cluster sitting in the lower-middle, while a line of stepping stones runs diagonally along the left edge. Concentric ripple rings centered on that cluster persist and subtly reshape moment to moment, marking an ongoing wave disturbance present from the first moment to the last. Milky cloud reflections shimmer and break apart slightly as the surface moves, though the reflected shapes do not drift. The lily pads stay in place, bobbing faintly with the passing waves rather than drifting. The far shoreline of trees, hills, and a dark angular roofed structure holds its position.
